boundary_oracle.local_critical: packet e is present in an admissible state S at anchor c and fidelity(S minus e) is below c
boundary_oracle.local_harmful: packet h is absent from S and fidelity(S plus h) is below c
boundary_oracle.stable_relation: retain e before h only when that direction is identifiable across the complete set of globally near-optimal nested chains

single_primary_objective.interpretation: optimize the worst contract-critical boundary inversion per example
